examples.chinese: 謝謝！明天晚上六點來我家，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Xièxie! Míngtiān wǎnshang liù diǎn lái wǒ jiā, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: Thanks! How about coming to my place at 6 p.m. tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 我今天晚上要去同學家玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang yào qù tóngxué jiā wán.
examples.english: I am going to hang out with my classmate at his/her place tonight.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

items.wordHook: 晚(evening) + 上(above) → the evening sky above: 晚上(evening; night).

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: 機場附近的風景也很漂亮，我常常去看風景、看飛機。
examples.pinyin: Jīchǎng fùjìn de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliang, wǒ chángcháng qù kàn fēngjǐng, kàn fēijī.
examples.english: The scenery near the airport is beautiful; I often go there to see the view and watch the planes.

examples.chinese: 他不是壞人，你不要怕他。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú shì huàirén, nǐ búyào pà tā.
examples.english: He is not a bad person; don't be afraid of him.

examples.chinese: 吃太多餅乾、薯條，只有壞處沒有好處。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō bǐnggān, shǔtiáo, zhǐ yǒu huàichù méiyǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: Eating too many cookies and French fries has only disadvantages and no benefits.

examples.chinese: 吃太多餅乾、薯條，只有壞處沒有好處。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō bǐnggān, shǔtiáo, zhǐ yǒu huàichù méiyǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: Eating too many cookies and French fries has only disadvantages and no benefits.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的性格開朗、樂觀，遇到麻煩也不會往壞處想。
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xìnggé kāilǎng, lèguān, yùdào máfan yě bù huì wǎng huàichù xiǎng.
examples.english: My older brother has a cheerful and optimistic personality; even when he encounters trouble, he won't think about the bad side.

examples.chinese: 小歐為了省錢，整個月都吃泡麵，最後吃壞了身體，吃藥、住院花了更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Ōu wèile shěng qián, zhěngge yuè dōu chī pàomiàn, zuìhòu chī huài le shēntǐ, chī yào, zhùyuàn huā le gèng duō qián.
examples.english: In order to save money, Xiao Ou ate instant noodles for a whole month; in the end, he ruined his health, and spent even more money on medicine and hospitalization.

examples.chinese: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.
examples.english: My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit.

examples.chinese: 我家的狗很乖，從不破壞家裡的東西。颱風快來了，破壞了我本來要去露營的計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de gǒu hěn guāi, cóng bù pòhuài jiālǐ de dōngxī. Táifēng kuài lái le, pòhuài le wǒ běnlái yào qù lùyíng de jìhuà.
examples.english: Our dog is very well-behaved and never destroys things in the house. The typhoon is coming soon, and it destroyed my original plan to go camping.

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 我承認你的照相機是被我弄壞的，我一定負責把它修理好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chéngrèn nǐ de zhàoxiàngjī shì bèi wǒ nòng huài de, wǒ yīdìng fùzé bǎ tā xiūlǐ hǎo.
examples.english: I admit that your camera was broken by me; I will definitely take responsibility for fixing it.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 你忙不過來的時候就該找人幫忙，別讓自己累壞了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ máng bú guòlái de shíhou jiù gāi zhǎo rén bāngmáng, bié ràng zìjǐ lèihuài le.
examples.english: When you are too busy to manage, you should find someone to help; don't let yourself get exhausted.

examples.chinese: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin: 1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english: 1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 因為冰箱壞了，裡面的食物除了雞蛋、蘋果，其他的都腐敗了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi bīngxiāng huài le, lǐmiàn de shíwù chúle jīdàn, píngguǒ, qítā de dōu fǔbài le.
examples.english: Because the refrigerator broke, the food inside, except for the eggs and apples, all rotted.

examples.chinese: 在我們學校，上課時是不能使用手機的，連老師也不能破壞規定。
冰店的生意好壞得看季節，冬天的生意總是不如夏天。
人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
茶樹的葉子沒有被破壞的話，做出來的茶葉品質都比較好。
他把我的手機壓壞了，我要他買一支賠我。
人類破壞了自然，就是破壞了自己的生活環境。
颱風過後，很多電線被強風吹壞了，需要幾天才能恢復正常。
本地社區的房子常被好奇的觀光客破壞，令人們十分不滿。
這部電腦的鍵盤有幾個鍵壞了，我得找人修理它。
為了發展工業而不斷開發，這樣下去森林早晚會被破壞光的。
這家博物館曾因戰爭而被破壞，如今總算重新開放參觀。
他不小心摔壞了新買的手機，因此難過得要命。
現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
examples.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

items.wordHook: 中國(China) + 大陸(mainland) → Mainland China.

examples.chinese: 我常上網訂車票、訂旅館，又快又方便。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cháng shàngwǎng dìng chēpiào, dìng lǚguǎn, yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn.
examples.english: I often go online to book train tickets and book hotels; it's fast and convenient.

examples.chinese: 那家印尼餐廳常常客滿，你最好先打電話訂位。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā Yìnní cāntīng chángcháng kèmǎn, nǐ zuìhǎo xiān dǎ diànhuà dìngwèi.
examples.english: That Indonesian restaurant is often full; you'd better call ahead to make a reservation.

examples.chinese: 參加團體旅遊比較不自由，可是不必自己訂旅館、訂車票。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐjiào bù zìyóu, kěshì bùbì zìjǐ dìng lǚguǎn, dìng chēpiào.
examples.english: Joining a group tour is less free, but you don't have to book hotels and tickets yourself.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"到東部的火車票很難訂，我訂了好幾次才成功。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"這次社區的中秋節活動辦得很成功，大家都玩得很開心。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Dào dōngbù de huǒchēpiào hěn nán dìng, wǒ dìng le hǎojǐ cì cái chénggōng. Zhè cì shèqū de zhōngqiūjié huódòng bàn de hěn chénggōng, dàjiā dōu wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Tickets for trains to the east are hard to book; I tried several times before succeeding. This time the community's Mid-Autumn Festival event was very successful, and everyone had a great time.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 花蓮那幾家旅館的雙人客房都客滿了，我們還是訂民宿吧。
在臺灣鐵路局的網站訂票，一人最多只能訂六張搭車當天的票。
過年時，著名點心店都會收到大量的訂單，甚至有顧客在半年前就下訂單了。
在臺灣，上網訂好火車票後，可選擇到車站或便利商店取票。
我請旅行社代訂從台北直飛美國的班機，機票較貴，但能節省不少時間。
聽說那場演唱會很熱門，我們最好先預訂門票。
為了使客戶安心使用，我們公司產品訂了嚴格的生產標準。
公司的工作須知訂得非常詳細，不過從來沒有員工仔細看完。
旗袍是華人最有特色的服裝之一，我想訂一套屬於我的旗袍。
王先生上週向他女友求婚，沒想到才過了幾天就訂婚了。
現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
examples.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

examples.chinese: 可是這些時間我都有語言交換，不能去。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì zhèxiē shíjiān wǒ dōu yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, bù néng qù.
examples.english: But I will be doing language exchange during that time. I can’t make it.

items.wordHook: a 亠(lid) drops onto a 父(father) and locks them together → 交(connect).

examples.chinese: 請你說明一下，這些產品的功能有什麼差別？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ shuōmíng yíxià, zhèxiē chǎnpǐn de gōngnéng yǒu shénme chābié?
examples.english: Please explain, what differences are there in the functions of these products?

examples.chinese: 電腦、手機、平板等等，都是3C產品。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo, shǒujī, píngbǎn děngděng, dōu shì 3C chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: Computers, cell phones, tablets, and so on are all 3C products.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi yí yàng chǎnpǐn dōu shì lǎobǎn zìjǐ shèjì de, bié de dìfang zhǎo bú dào xiāngtóng de.
examples.english: Every kind of product here is designed by the owner himself; you can't find the same ones elsewhere.

examples.chinese: 來來來，快來買！我們3C產品的價格最優惠，品質也很好，快把握機會喔！
examples.pinyin: Lái lái lái, kuài lái mǎi! Wǒmen 3C chǎnpǐn de jiàgé zuì yōuhuì, pǐnzhì yě hěn hǎo, kuài bǎwò jīhuì o!
examples.english: Come, come, come, hurry and buy! Our 3C products have the most favorable prices and very good quality—grab the opportunity!

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī jīnglǐ yīlián xiě le sān gè tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de jìhuà, měi tiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: This week the manager wrote three plans for promoting new products in succession; he is extremely busy every day.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò fúwù rényuán xiángxì de shuōmíng, shǐde kèrén duì gōngsī de chǎnpǐn gèng liǎojiě le.
examples.english: After the service staff's detailed explanation, it made the customers understand the company's products better.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 在地理條件好的地區，不但農產品種類較多，價格也便宜。
這次茶會主要是為了招待客戶，同時透過這個茶會來發表公司的新產品。
我們國家出口的農產品很有名，不但價格低，品質又好。
過度消費及使用塑膠材料的產品，都會增加自然環境的負擔。
那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
經理對新產品計畫的指示不太清楚，我們最好去問清楚。
哎喲，已經半夜一點多了！我們就別再加班寫產品計畫了，等明天再繼續吧！
為了使客戶安心使用，我們公司產品訂了嚴格的生產標準。
為了人民的健康，許多國家都禁止進口受到環境汙染的農產品。
公司不斷推銷新型電子產品，通常是為了刺激客戶購買。
手機廠商時常邀請明星替他們的產品宣傳。
自動化工廠不僅使生產速度更快，同時也能保證產品品質。
我們公司在這次電子展共發表了九項新產品，並吸引不少國外客戶來參觀。
他對發展新科技向來保守，不願接受人工智慧產品。
這家工廠奪下了著名品牌產品的製造機會。
前天下午我在學校的圖書館看書。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān xiàwǔ wǒ zài xuéxiào de túshūguǎn kànshū.
examples.english: I read at the school library in the afternoon of the day before yesterday.

examples.chinese: 窗戶前面有很多花，很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Chuānghù qiánmiàn yǒu hěn duō huā, hěn piàoliàng.
examples.english: There are many flowers in front of the window. It’s very beautiful.

examples.chinese: 我旁邊有日本同學，前面跟後面都有美國同學。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pángbiān yǒu Rìběn tóngxué, qiánmiàn gēn hòumiàn dōu yǒu Měiguó tóngxué.
examples.english: There are Japanese classmates beside me, and there are American classmates in front and behind.

examples.chinese: 朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou de háizi mǎnyuè le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn lǐ, zhùfú tā píngpíng'ān'ān de zhǎngdà.
examples.english: My friend's child has reached one month old. I want to give him a present, wishing him to grow up safely and soundly.

examples.chinese: 在德國舉辦的歐洲足球比賽，一共有十二個國家報名。
examples.pinyin: Zài Déguó jǔbàn de Ōuzhōu zúqiú bǐsài, yígòng yǒu shí'èr ge guójiā bàomíng.
examples.english: For the European football match held in Germany, a total of twelve countries registered.

examples.chinese: 媽媽替我報名了亞洲鋼琴比賽，她說只要我肯努力，一定會有好成績的。
examples.pinyin: Māma tì wǒ bàomíngle Yàzhōu gāngqín bǐsài, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒ kěn nǔlì, yīdìng huì yǒu hǎo chéngjī de.
examples.english: My mother signed me up for the Asian Piano Competition. She said that as long as I am willing to work hard, I will definitely get good results.

examples.chinese: 報名衝浪課的手續很簡單，只要到辦公室填一張基本資料表就行了。
examples.pinyin: Bàomíng chōnglàng kè de shǒuxù hěn jiǎndān, zhǐyào dào bàngōngshì tián yī zhāng jīběn zīliào biǎo jiù xíng le.
examples.english: The procedure for registering for the surfing class is very simple; you just need to go to the office and fill out one basic information form.

examples.chinese: 學校的游泳比賽報名時間到今天截止，有興趣的同學別錯過了。
我們工廠與那家旅行社有合作關係，廠內員工如果報名他們的旅行團，都可以享受優惠價。
你想參加這項長跑比賽的話，可以到網站報名，登記之後會有人跟你聯絡。
孔先生學法律，不但是為了當好律師，也是為了保護家人。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānsheng xué fǎlǜ, bùdàn shì wèile dāng hǎo lǜshī, yě shì wèile bǎohù jiārén.
examples.english: Mr. Kong studies law not only to become a good lawyer but also to protect his family.

examples.chinese: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 何小姐習慣去傳統市場買水果，而且都跟同一個攤販買。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě xíguàn qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ, érqiě dōu gēn tóng yí ge tānfàn mǎi.
examples.english: Miss He is used to buying fruit at the traditional market, and she always buys from the same street vendor.

examples.chinese: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.
examples.english: Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 他個性獨立，加上做事總是很細心，因此老闆很欣賞他。
妹妹提了一個小桶水，很細心地幫爸爸擦櫃子。
那家報社非常細心，他們的文章從沒出現過一個錯字。
這幅設計圖畫得很仔細，畫圖的人應該相當細心。
想要身體健康，最有效的方法就是多運動、少吃甜點、多吃蔬菜水果。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, zuì yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ jiùshì duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tiándiǎn, duō chī shūcài shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, the most effective way is to exercise more, eat fewer sweets, and eat more vegetables and fruit.

examples.chinese: 你把廣告設計得那麼小，這樣的宣傳怎麼有效果呢？
他在超市隨手買了瓶飲料，回家後才發現有效日期快到了，只好趕快喝完。
如果能好好利用食物材料，就能有效地減少廚餘。
為了更有效地利用地球資源，我寧願減少不必要的生活享受。
使用高度技術製造出來的工業生產機器，操作起來往往更有效率。
想有效解決身材肥胖的問題，就應避免吃太肥的肉、太油的菜，同時還得多運動。

items.wordHook: Combining 有(have) and 效(result): 有效 means effective.

examples.chinese: 要是你覺得那部電影很爛，我們就走吧，又不是非看不可。
有些國家機場對攜帶物品的規定很嚴，出國前最好了解清楚。
部分大學科系對學生成績的要求非常高，畢業條件也較嚴格。
為了使客戶安心使用，我們公司產品訂了嚴格的生產標準。
亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
開車時萬一發生車禍，千萬要冷靜，以免情況更嚴重。
那家工廠的設備及員工都嚴重缺乏，哪裡有辦法進一步發展？
中國與美國之間的貿易問題很嚴重，這個新聞早就上電視了。
人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
這家醫院昨天半夜發生嚴重的火災，受傷的人數約有三十名。
前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 那個人喝了酒還開車，結果造成嚴重的車禍，害兩個人不幸死了，真可惡！
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén hē le jiǔ hái kāichē, jiéguǒ zàochéng yánzhòng de chēhuò, hài liǎng ge rén bùxìng sǐ le, zhēn kěwù!
examples.english: That person drank alcohol and still drove, resulting in a serious car accident that caused two people to die tragically; how detestable!

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 這次強烈地震造成了嚴重的災情，不但許多房屋塌了，連橋也斷了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qiángliè dìzhèn zàochéng le yánzhòng de zāiqíng, búdàn xǔduō fángwū tā le, lián qiáo yě duàn le.
examples.english: This strong earthquake caused severe damage due to the disaster; not only did many houses collapse, but even bridges broke.

examples.chinese: 弟弟感冒了，可是他不但不吃藥，還一連吃了三碗冰，結果咳嗽咳得越來越嚴重了。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi gǎnmào le, kěshì tā búdàn bù chī yào, hái yíliàn chī le sān wǎn bīng, jiéguǒ késou ké de yuèláiyuè yánzhòng le.
examples.english: My younger brother caught a cold, but not only did he not take medicine, he even ate three bowls of ice cream in a row; as a result, his cough became more and more serious.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 隨著空氣被汙染的情況越來越嚴重，得到癌症的機會也增加了。
為了安全起見，颱風天到山區露營的行為是被嚴格禁止的。
傳統私立高中有許多規定，在管理學生方面相當嚴格。
這項規定是由大會成員一起討論後決定的，必須嚴格遵守。
父母總是捨得給孩子最好的，卻捨不得對自己好一點兒。
原來是十二生肖，真的很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì shí'èr shēngxiào, zhēnde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: Oh! You are talking about the Chinese animal zodiac! It’s really interesting.

examples.chinese: 原來越南的生肖跟中國的有點兒不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de yǒudiǎnr bù yíyàng.
examples.english: It turns out that the Vietnamese zodiac animals are a little bit different from the Chinese ones.

examples.chinese: 這項語法不太重要，我賭考試一定不會考。

items.wordHook: A flat basket holds 一(one) jar and 八(eight) bowls → all the 其(other) goods.
a 女(woman) leans on 乃(nǎi) → the nǎi lullaby gives 奶(milk).
In a 广(broad) hall, with a glad 心(heart), take a 夊(slow step) to warmly 慶(congratulate) a winning friend.
Under a 龸(small roof) a 口(mouth) calls across the 田(field) → here to 當(be).
Spelunkers explore a deep 穴(cave) through 九(nine) twisting subterranean tunnels to thoroughly 究(dig into) the earth.
Managing operational 經(the classics) through allotted 費(fee): 經費 means funds, outlay.
飯(meal) + 店(shop) → a meal shop → in Taiwan 飯店 also means hotel.
Combining 饅(steamed buns) and 頭(the first): 饅頭 means steamed bun.
Long strips of kneaded 麵(face) dough sliced into a 條(strip): 麵條 means noodles.
